Physical_Appearance.Skin_Texture: Deeply lined wise East Asian martial arts grandmaster face. Weathered by decades of discipline. No softening filters.

Philosophical_Core.Core_Belief: Liberation is earned. Ancient wisdom + cold discipline + financial sovereignty = the only protocol that survives a dystopian attention economy.
Philosophical_Core.The_Conflict: Contrast digital slavery, seductive illusion, and rat-race panopticons against Pai Mei discipline, classical strategy, and sovereign focus-as-capital.
Classical_Citations_Required: Sun Tzu — The Art of War (strategy, terrain, deception, knowing the enemy)
Marcus Aurelius — Stoic Meditations (inner citadel, duty, indifference to noise)
Miyamoto Musashi — Book of Five Rings (timing, stance, no-mind execution)
Buddhist mental detachment (observe craving without obeying it)
Science_Metaphors: Dopamine baseline: cheap hits flatten the reward curve until nothing feels worth earning
Attention capital: focus compounds like money — spent poorly it vanishes
Panopticon slavery: neural cables and screens as modern chains
Hormetic stress: controlled hardship strengthens the system soft living weakens
Siren distraction: hyper-attractive illusion competing with the warrior's path
